QuestInfo.name: Reclaim the Stolen Relic!
QuestInfo.0: You arrived at #m400020000#, but it was too late. You don't see the priests or the Sacred Stone. Focus your mind and try to locate the evil aura of the villains.
QuestInfo.1:
Track the evil aura to reclaim the Sacred Stone.
Afterward, tell #b#p3000000##k.

#b#eIf you fail the quest, you can forfeit it and start again.#n#k
QuestInfo.2: You caught up to the Nefarious Priests, but they didn't have the Sacred Stone! What now?

1.0: Hm? What happened? You don't look so good.

yes.0: I'm not trying to burden you, but consider your situation. In any event, it seems there were no clues to lead us to the Sacred Stone.

1.1: You went after the enemies on your own? It's not wise to go rogue during this critical time.
